title: studio landing (/studio): the header holds only the product wordmark — no account menu, breadcrumb or search — and most of the page is blank
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui maintainer (Studio owner) — a decision on the landing frame. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed on the maintainer's word: 「Studio 首页顶部只有一个标志，没有用户菜单、面包屑和搜索，大半屏是空白；在手机上打开 Studio 基本没法用，也没有"请在电脑上编辑"的提示立卡」.

## Maintainer quick-read

The `/studio` front door is a deliberate standalone frame whose only control is the product wordmark back to Home (`StudioLanding` in the console's `StudioRoute`). Should it get the console's standard header pieces and use the empty space?

## Seen on 2026-10-07 (1440×900)

The header shows only "ObjectOS": no account menu (profile, language, sign out), no breadcrumb, no search across packages, objects or flows. The package cards fill roughly the top third; the rest of the page is blank.

## Not repeated here

Studio below tablet width, including the missing "best on desktop" hint on phones, is objectstack-ai/objectui#11795 (its option A).

## Options

- **A** — reuse the console app header (account menu, search, notifications) with a *Studio* breadcrumb, and fill the landing with recent work (last edited packages, objects, flows) and starting templates.
- **B** — add only the account menu and a package search box.
- **C** — status quo.

## Recommendation

A: the landing is where an author starts every session.

## Environment

Source read on objectui `main` at `82500a7` and objectstack `main` at `033e5c53`. Live observations are from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass: `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` (objectstack `879bd38c`), console from objectui `179f6fe9`, Chromium 141 at 1440×900, signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *studio landing page header only wordmark no user menu no search empty page*: 0 hits (0 open, 0 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *studio front door add account menu and search, landing mostly blank*: 1 hits (0 open, 1 closed).

  - objectstack-ai/objectui#1171 (closed) — user menu on the console Home page, not the Studio landing
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11795 (open) — Studio on narrow screens and the best-on-desktop hint
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
